from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'src'),str(ROOT/'tests')]
from support.fresh_summary_fixture import grouped_selection,claim,draft_for
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_model import NarrativeModelRequest,NarrativeModelResponse,decode_model_draft
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_summary_assessment import prose_diagnostics,atomic_prose_diagnostics
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_model_runtime import build_model_request,decode_model_draft as decode_runtime
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_model_scoped import compile_scoped_model_view
from unit.test_narrative_reading_transport import reading_context

out=ROOT/'docs/plans/du11-source-closure-2026-10-18/review/architecture-quality-20261101/implementation-results/gate-rejection-followup-20261102'
author_path=out/'cwp-contract-followup.json'
author=json.loads(author_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
before={p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in author['delivery_files_sha256']}
assert before==author['delivery_files_sha256']
checks={p:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in author['product_source_and_fixture_checks']}
assert all(checks[p]==v['frozen']==v['actual'] for p,v in author['product_source_and_fixture_checks'].items())
matrix=author['test_impact_matrix']
matrix_actual={row['path']:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for row in matrix['matrix']}
assert all(matrix_actual[row['path']]==row['current_file_sha256'] for row in matrix['matrix'])
record=dict(author_sha256=hashlib.sha256(author_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),test_manifest=before,
            frozen_protected=checks,matrix_verified_paths=matrix_actual)
(Path(__file__).parent/'before.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
texts=('公司计划在项目建成后为工厂提供产能保障。','该安排仍须客户完成验收后方可投产。')
rewritten='公司已为工厂提供产能保障。'
selected=grouped_selection(texts,('conditional','conditional'))
request=NarrativeModelRequest.from_selection(selected)
response=NarrativeModelResponse('offline','independent-synthetic',request.prompt_version,
    json.dumps(draft_for(selected,[claim(rewritten,['e1','e2'],['g1'])]),ensure_ascii=False).encode())
observation=dict(issue='SEM-QUAL-01/T4-R4-CONDITION-SCOPE-LOSS',
    assessment='OPEN_PRODUCT_CAPABILITY_NOT_A_PASS_OR_FIXED_FIXTURE',
    source_text=list(texts),claim_text=rewritten,source_spans=[span.to_dict() for span in selected.evidence_spans],
    legacy=decode_model_draft(response,selected=selected),
    prose_diagnostics=prose_diagnostics(texts[0],rewritten,'actual'),
    atomic_diagnostics=atomic_prose_diagnostics(texts[0],rewritten,'actual'))
context=reading_context(selected)
context['groups']=context['groups'][:1]
scoped=replace(selected,reading_context=context)
request=build_model_request(scoped,reading_projection_version='reading-model-input/7')
view=compile_scoped_model_view(scoped,max_claims=40)
task=view.model_tasks[0]
parts=[part for part,sid in view.to_binding()['task_parts'][task.key].items() if sid in task.support_ids]
response=NarrativeModelResponse('offline','independent-synthetic',request.prompt_version,
    json.dumps({'drafts_by_task':{task.key:[dict(text=rewritten,basis_parts=parts,modality='actual')]}},ensure_ascii=False).encode())
observation['current_v7']=dict(prompt_version=request.prompt_version,support_ids=list(task.support_ids),
    basis_parts=parts,draft=decode_runtime(response,selected=scoped,reading_projection_version='reading-model-input/7'))
# Observe, do not lock this incorrect behavior into a passing regression oracle.
(Path(__file__).parent/'semantic-open.json').write_text(json.dumps(observation,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'legacy_status':observation['legacy']['status'],
    'legacy_review':observation['legacy']['claims'][0]['needs_review'],
    'v7_status':observation['current_v7']['draft']['status'],
    'v7_review':observation['current_v7']['draft']['claims'][0]['needs_review'],
    'diagnostics':[observation['prose_diagnostics'],observation['atomic_diagnostics']],
    'issue_still_open':True},ensure_ascii=False))
